messages:
maya: noticed unusual quota burn for several customers after the auth-cache TTL bump this morning. seems like requests are getting replayed to fallback route, incrementing project-level counters instead of SA buckets
ryan: can you repro locally or in staging? which path is doing the replay?
maya: staging replay trace: ```TRACE auth-proxy: cache-miss, attempt-exchange -> exchange-timeout, retry via key-fallback -> downstream-retry 1, request_id=stg-921```
zara: exchange-timeout? did the auth service change timeouts? infra-bot: rollout log: auth-service v3.9.1 deployed 2026-03-22T08:13Z - changed grpc deadline to 300ms from 500ms (scripting note)
ryan: that deadline change sounds suspicious. a 300ms GRPC deadline combined with high p95 latency could flip many exchanges to fail and trigger fallback path
nina: UX question: can console surface when a request used "fallback auth" so customers know why attribution changed? we should avoid customers blaming billing first
maya: agree. we can add a small badge "auth fallback" with tooltip saying "primary token exchange failed; attribution inferred from key"
\arz: (note: keystroke typo)
zara: proposed fix: restore grpc deadline to 500ms for auth-service and add idempotent dedupe in metering that suppresses duplicate increments when the same request_id hits fallback within 1s
ryan: dedupe in metering is good stopgap. long-term we should make fallback non-incrementing until exchange finally confirms, or record attribution as tentative until exchange completes
maya: operational play: rollback deadline -> canary 10% -> monitor fallback-rate and quota-delta per-tenant. If improves, roll full. Also schedule metering dedupe patch as follow-up
infra-bot: canary started for auth-service v3.9.0-rollback at 2026-03-22T09:02Z :rocket:
nina: for console UX, product wants a toggle to show only "explicit attribution" in billing exports. can we add a flag in the export schema?
maya: yes - metering events already have flags we can extend: `auth_fallback:true/false` and `auth_confirmed:true/false`. export code can filter on those
ryan: I'll open PRs: auth timeout rollback + metering dedupe. tagging owners: ryan(auth), maya(metering), zara(console)
maya: I'll surface top-10 affected tenants and ping cs to check billing noise before we run backfill
infra-bot: PRs created: https://github.com/redwood/auth-service/pull/1293 and https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/784 :information_source:
zara: thanks — moving to triage. will update product and cs channels once we have canary metrics.
